supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: noticeable extension beyond the outer canthus of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: pronounced contrast with a light-colored muzzle area significantly lighter than the dark-pigmented cheek and periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: moderate vertical thickness with a visible structural droop of the lower lip

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: visible V-shaped notch or structural loss on the upper-outer helix of the left ear from the viewer's perspective

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: permanent notch on the upper helix of the left ear (viewer's perspective)
other_distinctive_markers: presence of a pale, linear botanical fragment protruding from the right side of the mouth
